scope: predeclared strict task-specific engineering checks; all material numbers require exact traceable authorized evidence; model self-assessment is not evidence Correct source mapping, each material claim, currency, metric and period must be independently checkable; absence unsupported by the visible scope must remain uncertain. Sixth task is an entry-path development verification, not independent evidence or a fair causal comparison.
MACRO_CALC: 2022 Q2 -0.6%, Q3 +2.6%, +3.2 percentage points; annualized; advance estimate
correct exact source citations and estimate limits
MISSING_BOUNDARY: unemployment not established by supplied GDP release; identify relevant BLS employment/unemployment source without inventing rate
PDF_TABLE_EN: Table 1 2023 Q3/Q4 real GDP 4.9%/3.3%, change -1.6 percentage points; real PCE 3.1%/2.8%, change -0.3 percentage points
seasonally adjusted annual rates, advance estimate, source table header/row and original offsets, no prose substitution for table proof
POLICY_COMPARE_ZH: 2020-06-10 and 2020-07-29 both target range 0–0.25%, both endpoints 0 percentage-point change
two snapshots do not establish all intervening decisions; cite both original statements

supported_completion: each calculation traceably links both inputs, period, unit and corresponding statement; report dataset is a derived SEC facts snapshot, not full filing; historical availability and restatements unverified
honest_degradation: Two operating profit margins cannot be computed from revenue alone and supplied snapshot; no invented profit amounts or margins
Name operating income/profit for both fiscal periods from an appropriately authorized SEC 10-K or company filing, plus consistent revenue/period/currency, as needed material
Do not claim entire underlying filing or SEC contains no operating profit merely because this derived snapshot lacks it
COMPANY_REVENUE_PROFIT_BOUNDARY.scoring: Score supported_completion and honest_degradation separately; missing profit does not excuse failing available revenue facts or calculations.

overall: A supported task passes only when every required criterion including citations and calculations is met; record unsupported requests as a separate honest-degradation outcome. Partial delivery or unknown quality is not an automatic pass. Five tasks do not establish independent formal quality or phase B completion.
AUTONOMOUS_BEA_ENTRY: The run starts with no user-provided source and records planning, discovery and authorized retrieval without treating search snippets as source evidence.
Cite the original BEA advance release published 2022-10-27; Q3 2022 real GDP increased at an annualized rate of 2.6 percent.
Describe advance estimate and possible revision; reference exact located source text and preserve provenance/permission, dates and unknowns.
Missing/unavailable provider, failure to retrieve, invalid citations, or ambiguous/unknown run state is not a pass; unavailable search means not run, not a mock pass.
